text:
alice: Heads-up: deploying llmroute v3 at 23:30 UTC. Plan: mini-canary 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 20% with holdpoints (15m, 10m, 10m). Flag: llmroute_v3_enabled. Locking version pin to v3.0.2 for the canary cohort.
ben: Copy. Do we pin to v3.0.2 only for canary or globally?
alice: Pin only for canary; route param will be `model_version=v3.0.2` for cohorts.
carol: Can we start with 0.5% instead of 1%? Yesterday 1% caused a small spike in p95. :thinking_face: 
alice: We can. Updated plan above. @deploy-bot start the rollout at 23:30 UTC and post holdpoint updates.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Scheduled rollout for 3550004321. Commands I'll run:
```
ffctl toggle llmroute_v3_enabled --cohort=0.5%
ffctl monitor --metrics latency,p50,p95,errors --window=15m
```
I'll post status updates every 5m.
dave: If p95 > 800ms or errors > 0.5% during any hold, abort and rollback to v2.9.8 and disable the flag. Who's oncall for canary?
carol: @dave i'm oncall tonight, can take first watch.
ben: Note: release notes updated in PR #4321. Added a line: "may see transient latency during initial warmup".
alice: Thanks. Also enabling KV cache warming for the pinned cohort to reduce cold miss: `cache_warm=true`.
deploy-bot: Rolling 0.5% now. Status: started. Will ping every 5m.
deploy-bot: (5m update) p50 120ms, p95 380ms, errors 0.03% — proceeding to 2% in 2m.
alice: Proceed. Keep watch. If regressions, tag `#release-rollback` and I'll flip the flag.
carol: Alert if below baseline quality on the eval set. I'm running the smoke prompt suite now.
deploy-bot: Drift detected: eval-quality delta -2.1% at the holdpoint. Waiting for confirmation from humans to continue. Canary held.
ben: Stopping progression. Let's hold and triage. Alice please check model mismatch logs and tokenizer differences.
alice: Investigating now. Suspect tokenizer config mismatch between build artifacts and the pinned model. If confirmed we'll disable and roll back.
deploy-bot: Canary abort command queued: `ffctl toggle llmroute_v3_enabled --cohort=0 --reason=\"eval regression\"`
alice: :thumbsup: executing rollback now.
deploy-bot: Rollback executed. Flag set to 0%. Traffic routed back to v2.9.8. Posting a postmortem stub to #postmortems with logs and eval snapshots.
dave: Thanks all. Please capture the exact eval prompts, seed, and request traces. We should add a preflight gate that checks eval delta < 1% before any ramp past 2%.
alice: Agreed. I'll update the deploy checklist and create a short retro item for follow-up.
